physical_and_numeric_invariants.clock: elapsed proper seconds from each zbar20 IC; absolute age null

provider.domain_scope: Operational literal-source formula domain; no empirical percent-accuracy guarantee at very low T. Preserve and output CI-floor, CE-cap and excluded-DR-cooling contributions.
provider.cross_sections: AtomicProvider::reference().cross_section, pinned Verner fit, energy <=50000 eV; use existing fit cutoffs without changing binding thresholds
provider.numerical_scope: Canonical Rust binary64 point implicit integration with empirical refinement. No inherited FT03 root/interval or rigorous continuum certificate.
provider.ownership: Each absorbed photon owns one species event plus binding and heat E-chi. RR/DR and radiative cooling escape once. CI binding is a thermal sink once. Signed Compton transfer has opposing CMB reservoir. Thermal expansion work and photon redshift/boundary work have separate owners.

conservation.Y_response_floor: 1e-7 times each species element/H to baryon normalization; charge-constrained electron floor propagated from ionic floors
conservation.near_zero: Below the response floor or numerical resolution, report unresolved estimate/envelope; no detection, sign or relative-percent claim.
conservation.energy_photon_ledgers: Maintain inherited structural owner checks. New cumulative normalized ledger tolerance 1e-8 using max(total injected+initial energy or count, positive fixed unit floor); report raw dimensional residual too.
conservation.positivity: No clipping or extrapolation. Invalid iterate rejects/backs off; invalid accepted state fails the run.

feedback.radiation_stress: Retain actual ionizing U2. DeltaP_ion=nH*U2*eV_to_erg. delta_s=a^-3 integral a^3*(8piG/(3c^2))*DeltaP dt.
feedback.background_radiation: Estimate omitted stress from free streaming initially isotropic radiation at a_ref in the same metric; use the entire effective Omega_r fluid for a conservative envelope, with CMB subset identified. Ignoring only ionizing stress is insufficient.
feedback.directional_cmb: For local mu, T(mu,a)=Tref/sqrt((1-mu^2)*exp(-2*b)+mu^2*exp(4*b)); integrate T^4 angular moments. The use of isotropic Compton Tref is separately labelled.
feedback.interpretation: Perturbative diagnostic, not rigorous bound. Exceeding target lowers approximation accuracy claim or triggers one targeted feedback decision; never erase the computed histories. Paired numerical resolution does not resolve model error.

physical_and_numeric_invariants.unchanged: No physical/background/provider/closure/tolerance change except explicit refinement axis or named variant. No state clipping; retain all charge states and electron/baryon normalization. No rigorous root/interval certificate is imported or imposed.

publication_and_claim_ceiling: Contract presence and preparation PASS do not establish AX11/AX12 science PASS,convergence,empirical atomic accuracy,absolute IVP error,source posterior,full signed robustness or original-goal completion.

grid.interpolation: piecewise linear in ln(a) between ordered accepted neighbors; exact native matches exact; no extrapolation
grid.interpolation_error: UNKNOWN unless separately estimated; never silently add to a convergence guarantee

comparison.clock_columns: Retain candidate/reference proper time separately at matched zbar. Optional PROPER_TIME requires common elapsed-time overlap and two distinct zbar columns. No Tgas sorting or simultaneous time/zbar matching.
comparison.norms: For each observable report max_j|O_i(L_j)-O_k(L_j)|,signed endpoint differences and all milestone shifts. This is a sampled interpolated maximum,not a continuous supremum. Use physical units per observable; no mixed-unit scalar norm.

near_zero_floors.Y_formula: ionic Y floor=element nuclei/nb times1e-7; electron floor propagates HII+HeII+2HeIII charge contributions
near_zero_floors.proper_ne_U0_U2: No new resolution floor invented. Export dimensional differences as diagnostics with unresolved accuracy; a resolved claim for these requires separately justified floor/estimator.

milestones.convention: First upward x_i<threshold<=x_(i+1); theta=(threshold-x_i)/(x_(i+1)-x_i) applied to ln(a) and proper time independently; zbar=exp(-L_interpolated)-1. Retain additional crossings,initial-exact and NOT_REACHED withnull and represented interval.
milestones.meaning: local homogeneous xHII,not QV; interpolation uncertainty UNKNOWN

comparison.figure_semantics: Use time-ordered parametric Y(Tgas) branches; zeros masked for log display only; actual source/IC/refinement differences separately labelled.

refinement_matrix.release: After phase1 supplies complete baseline histories and measured per-case resources; bind exact configs before any refinement. First priority remains completed baseline5 and their plots.
refinement_matrix.full_interval: Each released refinement starts from its explicit identical physical zbar20 IC and completes tozbar4; no interpolated coarse checkpoint is called a refined full-history IC.
refinement_matrix.q0_angular_rule: For zero shear, isotropic source, angle-independent opacity and normalized weights, scalar equations are angle independent. Document this algebra and observed parity/normalization checks; this does not transfer to a nonzero-shear case.
refinement_matrix.no_sign_transfer: Never assign positive-shear numerical errors to negative-shear or half-amplitude histories. Untested contrast uncertainty is UNKNOWN or RESOLUTION_LIMITED, not a quantified upper bound.

negative_completion_release.condition: A negative/odd signed response is to receive resolved accuracy or quantified bound, or final C11 decision requires its missing component controls

half_amplitude_completion_release.condition: A half-amplitude response or amplitude scaling is to receive resolved accuracy or quantified bound, or final C11 decision requires its missing controls

refinement_matrix.conditional_releases: Release only the missing relevant component/case rows after actual results. Record each release and its cumulative allocation; this is neither blanket simultaneous execution nor permission to mark untested criteria PASS.
refinement_matrix.mixed_error: If component refinements reveal comparable interacting errors, authority binds one joint sequence before its execution. No automatic full Cartesian parameter sweep.
refinement_matrix.stopping: After baseline plus two levels, evaluate actual differences. If not asymptotic or above target, report exact resolution limit; a further finite sequence needs a declared scientific reason and new allocation. Do not keep refining merely to force a nonzero detection.

component_acceptance.three_level_evidence: T/E/A each requires baseline+two actual completed refined levels for the relevant case. Preserve D01 andD12; configuration changes alone are not evidence.
component_acceptance.fraction_target_interpretation: Inherited empirical absolute target for H/He fraction histories. Only assess with supported actual refinement estimates; not a theorem or new Tgas/U relative target.
component_acceptance.paired_differences: Delta_k=O_q,k-O_0,k at matched coordinate; then differences Delta1-Delta0 andDelta2-Delta1 for each applicable component. No transfer of positive-q uncertainty to negative/half-q.
component_acceptance.resolved_response: Above the locked absolute floor, supported total applicable paired numerical uncertainty must be<=0.1*abs(Delta); interpolation uncertainty cannot silently be assumedzero. Retain UNKNOWN/RESOLUTION_LIMITED if controls are missing or nonasymptotic.
component_acceptance.estimator: No Richardson order is fixed in advance. Require actual observed ratios,sign/trend and asymptotic plausibility for that observable; otherwise report successive differences/variation envelope with explicit lack of continuum guarantee. Three levels do not automatically establish a rigorous upper bound.
component_acceptance.component_combination: Keep temporal,energy,angle and interpolation contributions separate. Comparable interacting components require a specifically justified joint sequence before a combined-accuracy assertion. Do not assume independent errors or sum arbitrary estimates into a certificate.
component_acceptance.q0_angle: For zero shear with isotropic source,angle-independent opacity and normalized reflection-even weights,scalar equations are angle-independent. Existing q0 parity/normalization data support use of the same scalar baseline,with explicit algebra; this shortcut does not apply to q!=0.
component_acceptance.even_odd: Even=(O(+q)+O(-q))/2-O0,odd=(O(+q)-O(-q))/2. Both signs need applicable controls; odd/higher-order terms are allowed.
component_acceptance.null: A null or empirical upper envelope is legitimate only with applicable measured resolution and explicit estimator. Unmeasured response is unresolved,not a forced detection or below-all-floors theorem.
